resources.string: Track your income, expenses, and daily spending allowance.
Set your currency and next payday to get started.
Payday has arrived. Record any income you received and choose your next payday.
Record income such as your salary or allowance, then add expenses as you spend.
All entries are manual. Daily allowance covers today up to the day before payday, rounded down to two decimals. Salary is never credited automatically.
Your expenses or reserved funds exceed your balance. Daily allowance is zero until spendable funds are positive.
Remove “%1$s”? Your balance and daily allowance will be recalculated.
Use up to 2 decimals, without grouping separators.
Enter a positive amount with at most 2 decimals, up to 999999999999.99.
Check the amount, description, and date. Future entries must be marked as planned; received income and paid expenses must be dated today or earlier.
PHP, USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, AUD, CAD, CNY or INR
Currency is fixed while transactions exist. Existing amounts are never converted.
Money you want to keep for savings or upcoming bills. Reduce this reserve when you pay a reserved bill and record its expense.
Enter zero or a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
Choose a supported currency and a payday after today.
Could not refresh your budget. Displayed amounts may be outdated. Tap Refresh.
Could not confirm the change. Refresh to check whether it was saved before adding it again.
This record changed or already exists. Refresh and reopen the editor before trying again.
Wait for the budget to refresh before making changes.
Budget setup is missing. Apply supabase/allowances.sql to your backend.
Your session cannot access this budget. Sign out and sign in again.
Refresh your budget to see the current allowance.
Choose your currency and next payday first. Your entry form will open after saving.
Tap Add income or Add expense to set up your budget and record your first transaction.
Planned entries affect your forecast only. Future dates automatically select this option. Uncheck only after confirming the actual amount and date.
Confirm the actual amount and date received or paid. Saving moves this plan into your current balance once.
Declare the amount you expect and the salary date. It stays planned until you confirm Salary received in your transactions. This does not change your budget payday setting.

Current balance plus planned income minus planned expenses due on or before the selected date, including overdue plans. Estimates do not change your current daily allowance. Confirm receipt or payment to record actual amounts.
